thread:
olivia: Quick sync: we're doing the base-image rebuild today. New envelope format (v2) means the keystore operator needs asymmetric unwrap rights during the rollout. Need someone to own RBAC + audit fields.

alex: I can own RBAC. What's the minimum role?

olivia: We need roles/cloudkms.asymmetricDecrypter scoped to the attestation key resource. Prefer ephemeral access via Workload Identity + token exchange, not a permanent IAM binding.

mike: I'll build the token-exchange in the operator (STS flow). That way the pod's annotation triggers issuance and we avoid static IAM grants.

jana: I'll run the rebuilt image through the private scanner and hold on any high/critical CVEs. Note: the rebuild bumps libseccomp and openssl, so watch vuln output.

luke-sre: For canary safety, I'll add an unwrap healthcheck (45s timeout). If unwrap fails we flip to the fallback image in the fallback registry. Also add a metric `keystore_unwrap_failures` to alert if >5% over 10m.

sec-bot: Reminder: incident template /incidents/template/keystore_unwrap_failure will be used if failure threshold exceeded.

alex: Draft RBAC snippet (gated):
```yaml
bindings:
  - role: roles/cloudkms.asymmetricDecrypter
    members:
      - serviceAccount:sa-keystore-unwrapper@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```
mike: Role conditions can't read pod annotations; STS with signed JWT claim that includes pod annotation is the way. I'll own token-exchange PR.

olivia: Audit requirements from SOC: structured unwrap events with actor, key_id, envelope_version, image_digest, status, and retain 365d. Someone please add parsers for Splunk/BigQuery. Sample event below.

alex: I'll add SA + WI mapping and the audit patch, request quick sec review. Sample audit event to wire into parsers: {"ts":"2026-04-02T18:12:00Z","actor":"sa-keystore-unwrapper@redwood-prod","key_id":"projects/rebuild-keystore/locations/global/keyRings/base/cryptoKeys/attest-key-v2","envelope_version":"v2","image_digest":"sha256:feedface","status":"success"} 

jana: scanner results posted in thread; will block rotation on any criticals.

olivia: If you see logs like `google.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.AsymmetricDecrypt.permissionDenied` pause rollout and notify me.

luke-sre: Cutting canary at 18:00 PT. I'll include rollback play: revert to previous helm chart and mark image as banned in registry trust list.

mike: Token-exchange PR up in 30m.

olivia: After canary is green I'll publish a concise runbook and retention note for SOC. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
